name: Daisy Pure & Natural Sour Cream (Tub or Squeeze)
whyItWorks: Contains just one single ingredient: Grade A pasteurized cultured cream. Contains zero thickeners, gums, carrageenan, or artificial preservatives. Adds soothing fat calories to baked potatoes without chemical gut irritants.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Top hot baked potatoes or plain white rice. Use in moderation (1–2 tbsp) to keep fat easily digestible.
